<div class="editorial-page timeline-page"><header class="editorial-page-head"><p class="eyebrow-small">A CHRONICLE OF DISCOVERY</p><h1>科学史年表</h1><p>从显微镜到宏基因组，再到人工智能。这里展示小说涉及的主要历史节点；现代人物与研究事件属于虚构。</p></header><div class="timeline-lede"><span>1665 — 2026</span><p>科学不是由一个个完美的瞬间组成的。观察、争论、验证与修正，同样构成了它的历史。</p></div><div class="literary-timeline"><div class="timeline-event"><div class="timeline-event__year">1665</div><div class="timeline-event__node"></div><div class="timeline-event__body"><h2>显微镜中的另一种尺度</h2><p>胡克出版《显微图谱》，伦敦正经历严重鼠疫。</p><a href="chapters/volume-01/chapter-01.html">相关故事：纸上的霉 ↗</a></div></div>
<div class="timeline-event"><div class="timeline-event__year">1676</div><div class="timeline-event__node"></div><div class="timeline-event__body"><h2>一滴水里的生命</h2><p>列文虎克向英国皇家学会报告水样中的微小活动体。</p><a href="chapters/volume-01/chapter-02.html">相关故事：一滴水 ↗</a></div></div>
<div class="timeline-event"><div class="timeline-event__year">1796</div><div class="timeline-event__node"></div><div class="timeline-event__body"><h2>接种与信任</h2><p>詹纳进行牛痘接种实验，预防医学的历史继续改变。</p><a href="chapters/volume-01/chapter-07.html">相关故事：一个男孩的手臂 ↗</a></div></div>
<div class="timeline-event"><div class="timeline-event__year">1854</div><div class="timeline-event__node"></div><div class="timeline-event__body"><h2>疾病与地图</h2><p>斯诺调查伦敦霍乱，帕西尼观察与霍乱有关的弯曲细菌。</p><a href="chapters/volume-02/chapter-11.html">相关故事：布罗德街 ↗</a></div></div>
<div class="timeline-event"><div class="timeline-event__year">1867</div><div class="timeline-event__node"></div><div class="timeline-event__body"><h2>手术室的改变</h2><p>李斯特发表外科防腐相关研究，医院日常工作随之变化。</p><a href="chapters/volume-02/chapter-15.html">相关故事：洁净的手术室 ↗</a></div></div>
<div class="timeline-event"><div class="timeline-event__year">1882</div><div class="timeline-event__node"></div><div class="timeline-event__body"><h2>病原体的证据</h2><p>科赫报告结核病病原体研究，为病原学提供关键证据。</p><a href="chapters/volume-03/chapter-17.html">相关故事：白色病人 ↗</a></div></div>
<div class="timeline-event"><div class="timeline-event__year">1910</div><div class="timeline-event__node"></div><div class="timeline-event__body"><h2>东北的寒冬</h2><p>肺鼠疫防控成为公共卫生史的重要篇章。</p><a href="chapters/volume-03/chapter-19.html">相关故事：零下三十度 ↗</a></div></div>
<div class="timeline-event"><div class="timeline-event__year">1928</div><div class="timeline-event__node"></div><div class="timeline-event__body"><h2>霉菌与遗传</h2><p>弗莱明发现青霉素相关抑菌现象，格里菲思发表细菌转化研究。</p><a href="chapters/volume-03/chapter-22.html">相关故事：长霉的培养皿 ↗</a></div></div>
<div class="timeline-event"><div class="timeline-event__year">1944</div><div class="timeline-event__node"></div><div class="timeline-event__body"><h2>遗传物质</h2><p>艾弗里等提供DNA参与遗传转化的关键证据。</p><a href="chapters/volume-04/chapter-26.html">相关故事：白色沉淀 ↗</a></div></div>
<div class="timeline-event"><div class="timeline-event__year">1953</div><div class="timeline-event__node"></div><div class="timeline-event__body"><h2>双螺旋</h2><p>DNA结构研究汇合实验数据、模型与多位研究者的工作。</p><a href="chapters/volume-04/chapter-29.html">相关故事：一张尚未完成的照片 ↗</a></div></div>
<div class="timeline-event"><div class="timeline-event__year">1977</div><div class="timeline-event__node"></div><div class="timeline-event__body"><h2>另一种生命谱系</h2><p>沃斯与福克斯的核糖体RNA研究改写微生物的演化分类。</p><a href="chapters/volume-04/chapter-31.html">相关故事：第三种生命 ↗</a></div></div>
<div class="timeline-event"><div class="timeline-event__year">2007</div><div class="timeline-event__node"></div><div class="timeline-event__body"><h2>人体微生物组</h2><p>大规模微生物组研究逐步展现健康人的个体差异。</p><a href="chapters/volume-05/chapter-35.html">相关故事：人体地图 ↗</a></div></div>
<div class="timeline-event"><div class="timeline-event__year">2012</div><div class="timeline-event__node"></div><div class="timeline-event__body"><h2>新的研究尺度</h2><p>微生物组计划成果与基因编辑技术带来新的研究可能。</p><a href="chapters/volume-05/chapter-35.html">相关故事：人体地图 ↗</a></div></div>
<div class="timeline-event"><div class="timeline-event__year">2026</div><div class="timeline-event__node"></div><div class="timeline-event__body"><h2>从预测回到证据</h2><p>虚构主人公程屿面对复杂数据与科学结论的边界。</p><a href="chapters/volume-06/chapter-44.html">相关故事：失灵的预测 ↗</a></div></div></div><div class="reading-note">本页为小说配套年表。历史节点经过择要呈现，具体发生、发表与认可的时间可能不同；更细致的说明见各章末及<a href="appendices/chronology.html">详细年表</a>。</div></div>
